action_args.justification: The series has a strong trend (0.924) and strong seasonality (0.732), making it highly predictable. The model ranking is only moderately stable (Kendall tau 0.407) and error correlation is very high (0.868, 13 of 19 models in one redundant group), so the top-5 pool already captures the independent signal. Trimming 20% of that small pool removes the one weakest member (ONLY_CWT_rf) without overfitting to 3 noisy windows. The leader is a seed and the runner-up is statistically indistinguishable, so accepting is the right call.
